reason: The native selected-text counterpart is authorable as TextInputSelectedText, but both direct Fill and a nested font-style authoring path make selected glyphs disappear on the permitted headless route; the selection background remains visible and neither capture has red selected ink. Therefore a faithful selected-paint comparison is unavailable. Anima solid/gradient/stroke selected paint and reusable style references have original-font core/tool and both-engine SVG/canvas tests. Existing documented logical-box/radius differences remain intentional; no raster threshold hides them.
